description: A bearded man in a dark Victorian-style suit and waistcoat leans over a wooden table, lifting the lid of an ornate heart-shaped box of chocolates lined with white paper. The lid has a painted scene of a girl in a pink dress holding a grey-and-white cat. Scattered wrappers, a pink ribbon, a knife and a warm lamp glow fill the room. The painting appears full-bleed with no visible text or frame.
